name: Glena Vuele, the Hypnotic
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Guardians.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
Whenever your opponent uses the "shield trigger" ability of one of his shields, you may add the top card of your deck to your shields face down.
flavorText: "Quick! Look over there!"

name: Marching Motherboard
rulesText: Whenever you put another creature that has Cyber in its race into the battle zone, you may draw a card.
flavorText: "I can carry out 50 trillion calculations per second . . . about how to kick your butt!"

name: Azaghast, Tyrant of Shadows
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Dark Lords.
Whenever you put a Ghost into the battle zone, you may destroy one of your opponent's untapped creatures.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "Surprise! It's your deathday party."

name: Balesk Baj, the Timeburner
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Armored Wyverns.
Whenever this creature is attacking your opponent and isn't blocked, take an extra turn after this one.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
At the end of your turn, return this creature to your hand.

name: Vreemah, Freaky Mojo Totem
rulesText: Whenever you put another creature into the battle zone, each Beast Folk in the battle zone gets +2000 power and "double breaker" until the end of the turn. (A creature that has "double breaker" breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: It lays down savage jungle beats to help its friends lay down savage jungle beatings.

name: Betrale, the Explorer
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack players.
At the end of each of your turns, you may untap this creature.
flavorText: "Beep, beep beepbeep beep. Beep."

name: Cosmic Wing
rulesText: Choose one of your creatures in the battle zone. It can't be blocked this turn.
flavorText: "I'm flying. I'm flying! Whoo-hooo! I've never felt so free! I'm a breeze in the sky. I'm a dancer in the clouds. This is so amazing! Uh, how do I get down?"

name: Cyclolink, Spectral Knight
rulesText: Whenever this creature is attacking your opponent and isn't blocked, search your deck. You may take a spell from your deck, show that spell to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
flavorText: "You will meet your fate . . . as soon as I stop feeling so . . . dizzy. . . ."

name: Jil Warka, Time Guardian
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack players.
When this creature is destroyed, choose up to 2 of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone and tap them.

name: Kalute, Vizier of Eternity
rulesText: When this creature would be destroyed, if another Kalute, Vizier of Eternity is in the battle zone, return this creature to your hand instead.
flavorText: "Arise, Vizier of Eternity. Your aura is the poetry of time." —Hanusa, Radiance Elemental

name: Micute, the Oracle
rulesText: Whenever you put a Guardian into the battle zone, you may choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone and tap it.
flavorText: Whether it's an omen of doom or an omen of glory depends on which side of the battlefield you're on.

name: Mihail, Celestial Elemental
rulesText: Whenever another creature would be destroyed, it stays in the battle zone instead.
flavorText: "Time has stopped. Death is extinct. Forever is now. So I hope everyone has a good book to read, because we'll be here for a while."

name: Nexus Charger
rulesText:
Add a card from your hand to your shields face down.
Charger (After you cast this spell, put it into your mana zone instead of your graveyard.)
flavorText: "We have a problem: I failed geometry." —Mini Titan Gett

name: Tra Rion, Penumbra Guardian
rulesText:
Instead of having this creature attack, you may tap it to use its $tap ability.
$tap Choose a race. At the end of this turn, untap all creatures of that race in the battle zone.
flavorText: As news of Ballom's death spread, so did the rejoicing.

name: Unified Resistance
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Choose a race. Until the start of your next turn, each of your creatures in the battle zone of that race gets "Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle)."

name: Abduction Charger
rulesText:
Choose up to 2 creatures in the battle zone and return them to their owners' hands.
Charger (After you cast this spell, put it into your mana zone instead of your graveyard.)
flavorText: "We have learned all we can about these specimens. But just to be sure, let's probe them again."

name: Emperor Maroll
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Cyber Lords.
Whenever you put another creature into the battle zone, return this creature to your hand.
Whenever this creature becomes blocked, return the blocking creature to its owner's hand. (This creature stays tapped.)
flavorText: Half supercomputer, half supervillain, all superfreak.

name: Hokira
rulesText:
Instead of having this creature attack, you may tap it to use its $tap ability.
$tap Choose a race. Whenever one of your creatures of that race would be destroyed this turn, return it to your hand instead.
flavorText: "Change my diaper?! Dude, I'm 47 years old."

name: Impossible Tunnel
rulesText: Choose a race. Creatures of that race can't be blocked this turn.
flavorText: "The transdimensional warp portals are operational! I'll never have to drive to the laundromat again!" —Sopian

name: Kelp Candle
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack.
Whenever this creature blocks, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put one of them into your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Scout Cluster
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
Whenever you put another creature into the battle zone, return this creature from the battle zone to your hand.
flavorText: "Gotta go!"

name: Submarine Project
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put one of them into your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
flavorText: "Ballom's death changes nothing. Keep digging to the core." —Emperor Maroll

name: Tekorax
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, look at your opponent's shields. Then put them back where they were.
flavorText: The bigger the eyes, the better it spies.

name: Tentacle Cluster
rulesText: Whenever this creature is attacking your opponent and isn't blocked, you may choose a creature in the battle zone and return it to its owner's hand.
flavorText: "The heat-ray tentacle and the cold-ray tentacle are smashing successes. The lukewarm-ray tentacle needs some work." —Corile

name: Zeppelin Crawler
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack.
Whenever this creature blocks, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put one of them into your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Acid Reflux, the Fleshboiler
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack.
Slayer (Whenever this creature battles, destroy the other creature after the battle.)

name: Bat Doctor, Shadow of Undeath
rulesText: When this creature is destroyed, you may return another creature from your graveyard to your hand.
flavorText: "Great. Another failure. Maybe it's time to face the fact that my brain-surgery experiments just aren't going to-Wait! I've got an idea! Nurse, bring me six rusty spikes!"

name: Gabzagul, Warlord of Pain
rulesText: Each creature attacks each turn if able.
flavorText: "My minions! Here is tomorrow's schedule. 7-8: Morning workout. 8-9: Pain. 9-10: 'Ripping Out Spines' seminar. 10-11: Pain. 11-12: Fright practice. 12-1: Lunch. 1-2: Pain. 2-3: Arts & crafts. 3-4: Pain. 4-5: More pain. 5-6: Excruciating, unbearable pain. Sleep well!"

name: Grinning Hunger
rulesText: Your opponent chooses one of his creatures in the battle zone or one of his shields and puts it into his graveyard.
flavorText: "Evil has a healthy appetite. Death never stops stuffing its face. But nothing-nothing-is hungrier than hunger itself." —Stallob, the Lifequasher

name: Ice Vapor, Shadow of Anguish
rulesText: Whenever your opponent casts a spell, he chooses and discards a card from his hand, then chooses a card in his mana zone and puts it into his graveyard.
flavorText: "I'm having a bad day. Before Trox stuffed me into a microwave this afternoon, I used to be a Snow Faerie."

name: Necrodragon Izorist Vhal
rulesText:
This creature gets +2000 power for each darkness creature in your graveyard. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
While this creature has power 6000 or more, it has "double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields)."
flavorText: Its fangs drip with the spite of the world.

name: Slash Charger
rulesText:
Search a player's deck. You may take a card from that deck and put it into that player's graveyard. Then the player shuffles his deck.
Charger (After you cast this spell, put it into your mana zone instead of your graveyard.)
flavorText: "Life is short. And now it's shorter." —Azaghast, Tyrant of Shadows

name: Trixo, Wicked Doll
rulesText: Whenever this creature is attacking your opponent and isn't blocked, your opponent chooses one of his creatures and destroys it.
flavorText: "A trick for you. A treat for me."

name: Venom Worm
rulesText:
Instead of having this creature attack, you may tap it to use its $tap ability.
$tap Choose a race. Each creature of that race gets "slayer" until the end of the turn. (Whenever a creature that has "slayer" battles, destroy the other creature after the battle.)
flavorText: "Ewww. And I thought I was disgusting." —Gigazoul

name: Zombie Carnival
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Choose a race. Return up to 3 creatures of that race from your graveyard to your hand.
flavorText: "Don't just sit there like a corpse-get up and dance!" —Bat Doctor

name: Aerodactyl Kooza
rulesText:
While attacking a creature, this creature can't be blocked.
Power attacker +3000 (While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power.)
flavorText: Never say anything an aerodactyl is likely to agree with. Having it nod at you can be fatal.

name: Blizzard of Spears
rulesText: Destroy all creatures that have power 4000 or less.
flavorText: "That's my kind of winter wonderland." —Bazagazeal Dragon

name: Fists of Forever
rulesText: Choose one of your creatures in the battle zone. Whenever that creature wins a battle this turn, untap it.
flavorText: "The forces of Darkness conquered the Fiona Woods but never tamed it. Its twisted horrors of nature cost Ballom his life. Let me convince some friends to do a little gardening." —Chaotic Skyterror

name: Gigio's Hammer
rulesText:
Instead of having this creature attack, you may tap it to use its $tap ability.
$tap Choose a race. Each creature of that race attacks this turn if able and gets "power attacker +4000" until the end of the turn. (While attacking, a creature that has "power attacker +4000" gets +4000 power.)

name: Quakesaur
rulesText: Whenever this creature is attacking your opponent and isn't blocked, your opponent chooses a card in his mana zone and puts it into his graveyard.
flavorText: Its blood is magma. Its saliva is also magma. (You can probably guess what its snot and pus are.)

name: Relentless Blitz
rulesText: Choose a race. This turn, each creature of that race can attack untapped creatures and can't be blocked while attacking a creature.
flavorText: At the signal, the warriors fell upon their foes like a crashing wave, leaving nothing but destruction in their wake.

name: Shock Trooper Mykee
rulesText:
Speed attacker (This creature doesn't get summoning sickness.)
Whenever this creature is attacking your opponent and isn't blocked, you may destroy one of your opponent's creatures that has power 3000 or less.

name: Simian Warrior Grash
rulesText: Whenever one of your Armorloids is destroyed, your opponent chooses a card in his mana zone and puts it into his graveyard.
flavorText: "Thanks to my fist cannons, I can punch someone in the face from up to two miles away!"

name: Snaptongue Lizard
rulesText:
While attacking a creature, this creature can't be blocked.
Power attacker +3000 (While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power.)
flavorText: It tastes your fear. Actually, it tastes everything.

name: Steam Rumbler Kain
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, choose one of your shields and put it into your graveyard.
flavorText: When it's not sifting through rubble, it's usually creating new rubble.

name: Cavern Raider
rulesText: Whenever this creature is attacking your opponent and isn't blocked, search your deck. You may take a creature from your deck, show that creature to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
flavorText: "My guidance counselor always told me I should be an action hero. She was right!"

name: Dance of the Sproutlings
rulesText: Choose a race. You may put any number of creatures of that race from your hand into your mana zone.
flavorText: "It is time for a new forest. It is time for the sproutlings. I'll go get the freaky golden head-statue thing we always use for that." —Fighter Dual Fang

name: Mana Bonanza
rulesText: For each card in your mana zone, put a card from the top of your deck into your mana zone tapped.
flavorText: "Fertilizer and plant food are decent, I guess, but a gigantic, floating megacrystal does the trick every time." —Tangle Fist, the Weaver

name: Silvermoon Trailblazer
rulesText:
Instead of having this creature attack, you may tap it to use its $tap ability.
$tap Choose a race. Creatures of that race can't be blocked by creatures that have power 3000 or less this turn.
flavorText: "Follow me."

name: Solid Horn
rulesText: When this creature would be destroyed, put it into your mana zone instead.
flavorText: It has a simple philosophy: If it sees an enemy, it fights. If it doesn't see an enemy, it looks for one.

name: Storm Wrangler, the Furious
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Beast Folk.
Whenever this creature attacks, you may choose one of your opponent's untapped creatures that has "blocker." This turn, that creature blocks this creature if able and this creature can't be blocked by other creatures.
Whenever this creature becomes blocked, it gets +3000 power until the end of the turn.

name: Terradragon Anrist Vhal
rulesText:
This creature gets +2000 power for each of your other nature creatures in the battle zone. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
While this creature has power 6000 or more, it has "double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields)."
flavorText: The ever-increasing cries of the world only fuel the Dragons' anger.

name: Vine Charger
rulesText:
Your opponent chooses one of his creatures in the battle zone and puts it into his mana zone.
Charger (After you cast this spell, put it into your mana zone instead of your graveyard.)
flavorText: Today's powerbot is tomorrow's flowerpot.

name: Whip Scorpion
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
Power attacker +3000 (While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power.)
flavorText: "I hate it when my pets fill up on junk food." —Storm Wrangler, the Furious

name: Whispering Totem
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, search your deck. You may take a Whispering Totem from your deck, show that creature to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
flavorText: "Psst . . . come closer . . . closer . . . . Wanna hear a secret? I hate woodpeckers."

name: Petrova, Channeler of Suns
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, choose a race other than Mecha del Sol. Each creature of that race gets +4000 power.
Whenever your opponent would choose a creature in the battle zone, he can't choose this one. (It can still be attacked and blocked.)
flavorText: "When I awoke, I thought it was noon. Then I realized the sun was still down . . . but Petrova was overhead." —Fear Fang

name: Aqua Master
rulesText: Whenever this creature is attacking your opponent and isn't blocked, choose one of your opponent's shields and turn it face up. (It stays face up while it's in the shield zone.)
flavorText: "You can't hide information from the Cyber Lords. Haven't you figured it out yet? Your brain's been wired into the Ultracomputer!"

name: Stallob, the Lifequasher
rulesText:
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
When this creature is destroyed, destroy all creatures.
flavorText: "You fools. I wasn't called the Master of Death for nothing! Your victory is your defeat. Your triumph is your coffin. I have voided my own demise, and from the abyss I am reborn. . . ."

name: Magmadragon Ogrist Vhal
rulesText:
This creature gets +3000 power for each card in your hand. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
While this creature has power 6000 or more, it has "double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields)."
While this creature has power 15000 or more, it has "triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields)" instead of "double breaker."

name: Stratosphere Giant
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, your opponent chooses up to 2 creatures in his hand and puts them into the battle zone.
Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields.)
flavorText: Born from the pain of the Fiona Woods, it finally put an end to Ballom's reign. With its foot.
